fixture: fresh generated normal BodyLoop for each run; no saved user body
training: only receipts of actual core-selected native requests; never preferences, assessments or deferrals
enforce_precondition: current exact walk/duration context has at least three verified samples and passes the existing gate
stop: stop after any failed, incomplete, unexecuted or unassessed live run; preserve its session and evidence; do not reset or invent success
acceptance: all four turns complete through the existing Agents API runner
each turn calls assess_body_action and receives a reduced self-model report
each run contains exactly one actual native cycle
the final run uses enforce mode and the actual core choice is checked before the native callback
every learned sample matches a committed body receipt
all remote sessions are deleted after their terminal result
a fresh process reopens the completed final goal with zero network calls and zero new body cycles
limits: connectivity and persistence check, not an independent generalization or performance study; repeated deterministic synthetic starting fixtures may have identical hashes; no probability of consciousness is measured
